prompt: A matrix run failed overnight in a few combinations. Put the recovery in order.
explanation: Scope, re-run, then diagnose what persists: see which combinations failed, re-run exactly those, and only dig into logs when the failure survives a clean retry. Flakes die at step 3; real bugs introduce themselves at step 5.

options.text: Open the failed run on the Actions tab
Expand the matrix to see which job combinations failed
Watch the re-run recreate only the failed combinations
If the re-run fails again, read the failed jobs’ logs for the real cause
